ai_summary: Alivus Life Sciences Limited has received an order from the Central Goods & Service Tax Department, demanding approximately Rs. 51.22 lakhs (plus applicable interest) for alleged unpaid GST and penalty spanning FY 2020-21 and 2021-22. While the order was issued under Section 74(1) of the CGST Act, implying potential fraud or misstatement, the company asserts there will be no material financial or operational impact and plans to assess exercising its right to appeal.
